value: Saltspire is a trade city built across a ring of black basalt sea-stacks, linked by rope-and-iron bridges. Storms never fully break here. Its three districts are the Tidemarket on the lower spans, the Lantern Spire crowning the tallest stack, and the flooded Underkeel below the waterline. Power is split between the Lantern Guild above and the Underkeel Pact below.
title: Saltspire

value: The Lantern Spire is the tallest sea-stack in Saltspire and the seat of the Lantern Guild. A storm-glass beacon burns at its peak, guiding ferries through the reefs. The Spire houses the Guild's marshals and its registry of Ember-bearers.
title: The Lantern Spire

value: The Underkeel is the warren of half-flooded basalt caverns beneath Saltspire's waterline, reachable only at low tide or by knowing the right tunnels. Smugglers, unregistered Ember-bearers, and the Underkeel Pact make their home here, out of reach of the Lantern Guild's marshals.
title: The Underkeel

value: The Lantern Guild governs Saltspire from the Lantern Spire. It licenses trade, keeps the beacon lit, and requires every Ember-bearer to register and wear a guild brand. Marshal Veyra Tolm leads its marshals. The Guild fears the Underkeel Pact above all.
title: Lantern Guild

value: The Underkeel Pact is a loose brotherhood of smugglers and unregistered Ember-bearers who refuse the Lantern Guild's brand. They control the Underkeel's tunnels and the black market that runs through them. Old Coromb brokers most of their dealings. The Pact swears its oaths to the Drowned Mother.
title: Underkeel Pact

value: The Drowned Mother is the sea-deity most of Saltspire quietly worships: patron of storms, of safe harbor, and of the dead lost beneath the waves. The Underkeel Pact swears its oaths in her name. The Lantern Guild calls her worship superstition, but few marshals sail without a coin for her.
title: The Drowned Mother

value: Marshal Veyra Tolm commands the Lantern Guild's marshals. She is broad-shouldered, grey at the temples, and incorruptible. She has hunted the Underkeel Pact for a decade and lost a brother to it. She is courteous to strangers and merciless to oath-breakers.
title: Marshal Veyra Tolm

value: Old Coromb is the Underkeel Pact's fixer, a stooped, soft-spoken man who has brokered every important smuggling deal in Saltspire for thirty years. He trades in favors more than coin and remembers every one owed. He is the one contact named in your soaked letter.
title: Old Coromb
